title: "Wind Resource and Layout"
completion: 70
---

## Role in the Model

This section converts a directional offshore wind resource and a turbine layout into wake-adjusted farm power states and annual energy production. These outputs determine gross wind-farm yield and provide the operating states used by the electricity and hydrogen conversion calculations.

The calculation is performed in dependency order:

1. fit a directional wind-speed distribution;
2. place the selected number of turbines inside the modelled farm area;
3. assign turbine power and thrust-coefficient curves;
4. calculate wake-affected power for each wind-speed and direction state;
5. probability-weight the states to obtain annual energy production; and
6. pass the wake-aware power table to downstream conversion calculations.

## Calculation Boundary

| Included here | Accounted elsewhere |
|---|---|
| Directional wind-resource distribution | Turbine mass and supply cost |
| Turbine coordinates and separation | Electrical and hydrogen infield-network topology |
| Turbine power and thrust inputs used by the wake model | Availability and infrastructure losses |
| Wake-affected and no-wake farm power | Export-system and hydrogen-conversion calculations |
| Wake loss and wake-adjusted gross capacity factor | Installation, operating and decommissioning cost |

Infield cable and pipeline design is intentionally excluded from this section. Those calculations use the turbine coordinates but are documented on [Infield AC Cables](../electrical_infra/infield_ac_cables.qmd) and [Hydrogen Infield Infrastructure](../hydrogen_infra/infield_infrastructure.qmd).

## Principal Outputs

| Output | Unit | Downstream use |
|---|---:|---|
| Wind-state probability | fraction | Annual energy and operating-state weighting |
| Turbine coordinates | m | Wake calculation and infield-network length |
| Wake-aware farm power by state | MW | Electricity and hydrogen conversion |
| No-wake annual energy | MWh/year | Wake-loss reference |
| Wake-adjusted annual energy | MWh/year | Gross wind-farm yield |
| Wake loss | fraction | Energy-loss attribution |
| Wake-adjusted gross capacity factor | fraction | Farm performance and utilisation |

The current implementation is suitable as a transparent screening calculation, but its wind-data provenance, directional bin alignment, turbine performance curve and layout feasibility treatment require improvement before the results are treated as a validated energy assessment. The specific improvements are stated on the two calculation pages.
